interfaceReference.scope: runner code shape only; never loaded old fixture or quality outputs

checks.name: runner-compatible arrays and exact declared counts
unique documents, independent main/distractor pairing and balanced source languages
sources are two or three sentences and bounded nonempty UTF8 text
twenty positives per language direction and two references per main source
query identities are unique and positive questions are not copied source sentences
pure OOD labels and languages are separate from unsupported diagnostics
all184 question strings are distinct and OOD never names a complete corpus identifier
every complete positive/exact ID matches its relevant original source
no previous acceptance fixture or model adapter imported

labelReview.method: Author reviewed each positive against its complete synthetic main source, each adjacent distractor against the distinct question intent, all OOD against the full authored corpus, and each near-topic missing attribute against its related source. No retrieval/model scores were consulted.
labelReview.ood: Pure OOD asks for no provided procedure/entity/fact. Broad everyday wording may overlap; questions about missing attributes of a corpus entity are separately labelled unsupported.
labelReview.unsupported: Absent names, schedules, counts, contact details, compensation, prices or extension limits remain diagnostic and never dilute the OOD denominator.
labelReview.automatedScope: The structural checks do not prove semantic label correctness or expected model quality.

rules: Do not tune model/threshold/prompts/implementation using this fixture. Existing train/calibration remains the only selection source.
No model or lexical/semantic retrieval run at freeze. Next final independent qualification must bind this exact fixture hash and the fixed candidate/source hashes.
No old acceptance-v2/v3/v4 fixture, specific queries or quality report was read for authoring. Runner code interface alone was inspected.
Synthetic names, identifiers, policies and examples only; no user data, medical/legal advice, factual-answerability or external-authority claims.
Do not share concrete queries with implementation agents. Report only hash, counts, schema checks and label-review limitations.
Do not overwrite freeze or change labels after any results; any correction needs a new explicitly versioned qualification decision.
